title: Arrest in lieu prohibited
question: What does Acja 2015 section 7 say about arrest in lieu prohibited?
shortAnswer: Acja 2015 s.7 — No person arrested for another's offence.
legalExplanation:
**Section 7 of the Acja 2015** provides:

No person arrested for another's offence

This provision empowers Acja 2015 officers with specific powers and duties.
practicalOptions: Stay calm. Know your rights. Ask for identification. Do not resist. Ask for lawyer. Document everything.
whatToAvoid: Do not run, bribe, resist, destroy evidence, or sign without lawyer.
whatToDocument: Officer name, agency, badge, vehicle, time, location, witnesses, injuries, photos/video.
whatToDoAfter: Get lawyer. File complaint with agency complaints unit or ICPC/PCR. Demand court within 24h. Document injuries.
reviewNotes: Approved after review from Acja 2015 s.7. Needs plain-language review and verification against official gazette.
